info.name: Dispatch Load Balancer
info.description:
All endpoints of the Dispatch Load Balancer, including validation errors and edge cases.

Set the collection variable `baseUrl` (default http://localhost:8080, or the deployed Render URL). Run the whole collection in order with the Collection Runner: every request has tests. Folder 1 resets the data first, so the run is repeatable.

item.name: 1. Happy path
item.description: Loads the 30-order / 5-vehicle sample dataset (samples/*.json) and plans it with each strategy. Total order weight 645 exceeds fleet capacity 500, so some LOW orders are intentionally unassigned.

item.name: 3. Validation errors
item.description: Every error uses one shape: {"status":"error","message":"...","errors":["field: reason"],"timestamp":"..."}. None of these requests change stored data.

exec: pm.test("error mentions the allowed priorities", () => pm.expect(text).to.include("HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW"));

request.description: Fractional weights are rejected instead of being silently truncated to 10.

exec: pm.test("lists the allowed priorities", () => pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.include("HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW"));
